annotation.title_clean: Arizona Revised Statutes 13-3729. Unlawful operation of model or unmanned aircraft; state preemption; classification; definitions
annotation.title_en: Arizona Revised Statutes 13-3729. Unlawful operation of model or unmanned aircraft; state preemption; classification; definitions
annotation.summary_en: Arizona statute criminalising certain drone and model aircraft operations: those violating federal aviation rules, interfering with emergency services, loitering over critical facilities, flying near ticketed events, or hobby flights over schools. Sets felony and misdemeanor penalties, exemptions for FAA-authorised and first-responder use, and definitions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Unlawful to operate drones in violation of federal aviation rules or interfering with emergency operations
Photographing or loitering over critical facilities in furtherance of a crime is a class 6 felony
Civil drones barred within 5,280 feet of ticketed entertainment events without consent
Hobby drone flights under 200 feet over K-12 school property restricted
Exemptions for FAA-authorised operators and first responders
